description: Source-camera rays turned into the raw splat frame (marble_raw_opencv: x right, y down, z forward). A camera ray uses the same axes. Pitch tilts the camera up (toward -y) first, then yaw turns it right (from +z toward +x), so yaw matches Marble's azimuth (0 front, 90 right, 180 back, 270 left). The simple cases are worked out by hand; the last two were derived with explicit rotation matrices and checked by hand. The pipeline's photo matcher and the TypeScript core both check against this file.
